description: Separate Workflow Profile metadata, pure Definition behavior, and independently owned Project, Issue, and WorkflowRun Variables.

tasks.title: Migrate Workflow Profiles to pure Definition assets
tasks.description: Introduce the Profile envelope carrying id, name, description, and a pure Definition; migrate project and issue custom-template persistence and API assembly to that shape. Refactor Definition domain types, serializers, catalog assets, and resolver call sites so Project defaults, Issue selection, built-ins, startup, and later-stage loads all use the same Profile boundary; include the one-shot persisted-profile migration and removed-field diagnostics.
acceptanceCriteria: WorkflowDefinition and StageDefinition no longer model Profile metadata, top-level defaults/artifacts, or embedded Variables; task-level artifacts, recovery, and setVars remain executable Definition behavior

Definition YAML and JSON conversion preserves approval and stages, emits no removed fields, and rejects id, name, description, variables, defaults, top-level artifacts, and stage.variables without becoming a general unknown-field validator

Project templates and Issue custom Profiles persist and return Profile metadata separately from their pure Definition, while Project default and Issue selection continue to resolve by Profile identity

The built-in catalog, rather than built-in YAML, supplies the existing Local and GitHub PR names, descriptions, and default designation; both built-in Definitions retain their ordered executable stages
Workflow startup and a later stage entry resolve custom Issue, referenced Project, Project-default, and built-in Profiles through the same resolver without deriving metadata from a Definition

The persisted-profile migration preserves storage identities, writes Profile envelopes for convertible records, and reports a named Profile plus Variable paths for records requiring an explicit Variables relocation; no dual-read compatibility path remains

Spec/unit coverage updates the existing WorkflowProfileCatalog, Mohist Local/GitHub PR profile, project-template, issue-profile, template-selection, stage, and YAML serializer specs for all Profile and Definition scenarios
npm run build and npm test pass
tasks.output: Pure WorkflowDefinition/Profile envelope domain and persistence conversion, built-in catalog and assets, unified profile resolver/API call sites, one-shot migration, and focused server specs
tasks.notes: Also implements specs/workflow-definition-language/spec.md. Keep the language parser narrow: explicitly reject only the removed known fields; #432 owns broad unknown-field validation. Do not introduce a new Profile collection or Settings UI.

tasks.title: Resolve Variables only from Project, Issue, and WorkflowRun resources
tasks.description: Remove global-config and Definition-derived Variables from effective resolution, retaining the existing deep merge and selected-stage behavior for Project, Issue, and WorkflowRun resources. Seed Issue agent and WorkflowRun archive defaults in their owning resources without overwriting explicit values, and keep setVars-backed Run writes visible to retries and stage re-entry.
acceptanceCriteria: Effective Variable resolution consults only Project, Issue, and WorkflowRun VariableBundles; Profile parsing, Definition loading, and live stage reads cannot add a Variable source

Project, Issue, and WorkflowRun Variables deep-merge in that order, and selected-stage overlays preserve the same resource precedence; explicit Project, Issue, stage, and Run values continue to override defaults

Built-in workflow startup ensures Issue vars.agent is an empty object and WorkflowRun vars.archive is an empty string when absent, while preserving explicitly supplied values and remaining idempotent across repeated start attempts
setVars continues to patch WorkflowRun Variables only, and a task retry or stage re-entry resolves the latest persisted archive value rather than a Definition or dispatch snapshot
Global config Variables do not affect effective Workflow Variables after the switchover

Focused specs cover no embedded-variable contribution, scope and stage precedence, built-in agent/archive initialization, preserved explicit overrides, and archive visibility after retry or re-entry without real time or external dependencies
npm run build and npm test pass
tasks.output: Three-resource Variable resolver, idempotent Issue/WorkflowRun default initialization, live Run-variable dispatch behavior, and focused server specs
tasks.notes: T-001 removes Definition-owned Variables and supplies the pure Profile resolver consumed by this task. Reuse VariableBundle merge semantics and existing Project, Issue, and Run storage/API routes; do not rename or migrate those resources.
